qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the engine oil cooler to body connection?
Does the engine oil cooler to body torque specification apply to all E30 models?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, it applies to all models as indicated by 'All' in the Type column.

qa_pairs.question: Is the oil cooler vapor extraction guide specific to certain models?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, it is specific to the E36 M3 model only.

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers the Engine Oil Cooler specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 17-3 Radiator, subsection 17 21 Engine Oil Cooler

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque specifications between the engine oil cooler to body and the vapor extraction guide connections?
qa_pairs.answer: The engine oil cooler to body requires 14 Nm while the vapor extraction guide requires only 4 Nm, a difference of 10 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What component uses the 1AZ designation?
qa_pairs.answer: The engine oil cooler to body connection uses the 1AZ designation.

qa_pairs.question: Are there any special tools or procedures mentioned for these oil cooler connections?
qa_pairs.answer: No special tools or procedures are mentioned on this specification page, only the torque values and screw types are provided.

qa_pairs.question: Which oil cooler component has a higher torque requirement?
qa_pairs.answer: The engine oil cooler to body connection has the higher torque requirement at 14 Nm compared to the vapor extraction guide at 4 Nm.
